options.text: I need the mule for the diggings road.

exchange.speaker: livery_man
exchange.line: You don't hire Grievance. You apply. She'll look at you. Then we'll know.

options.say: Had a partner once. She took his side.
She's fine. She's just got a view.
That's what the fella whistled. Twelve years I've been getting it wrong.

exchange.speaker: livery_man
exchange.line: She's not using it. Bring it back before she notices.

options.text: Has she ever moved for anybody?

exchange.speaker: livery_man
exchange.line: Once. Twelve years back. Fella came in at night, whistled at her, and she walked out after him like she'd been waiting.

exchange.speaker: livery_man
exchange.line: Never saw him again. Never saw her move again, either.

options.text: Have you ever been in the Liar's Assay?

exchange.speaker: livery_man
exchange.line: Once. Fella told me, 'I once bought a saloon with a single nugget.' I said, 'I have been in it. You overpaid.'

exchange.speaker: livery_man
exchange.line: He's never forgiven me. Still owns the saloon.

options.text: I've taken enough of your time. I'll be taking more later.
